description: Defines a singleton class HostNameSupplier that provides the hostname by first checking an environment variable and falling back to the local host address if the variable is unset.

classes.name: HostNameSupplier
classes.description: Immutable singleton class that supplies the hostname by environment variable or local host address.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HostNameSupplier.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the hostname either from the environment variable or by resolving the local host address.

methods.name: tryToGetHostnameFromLocalHostAddress
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the hostname from the local host address, throws DittoServiceError if it fails.

methods.name: getHostnameFromLocalHostAddress
methods.description: Gets hostname from InetAddress.getLocalHost(), throws UnknownHostException if unable to resolve.
